speaker: george_bryan
text: I will ask it carefully. A play of a king put down. Will it pass the Master?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It's in the chronicle.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The chronicle is not a licence. I have stood in a presence chamber when a smaller thing was stopped, and the smaller thing was only talk.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we do not play it until the Inns are back, and we do not play it green. Michaelmas was the word.

speaker: will_kemp
text: What part have I in the king?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The parts are not cast.

speaker: will_kemp
text: That is an answer, and it is not a part. A part can be uncast and still be meant for me, or not meant.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not cast. There is no paper with your name on it. There is no paper with anyone's name on it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Leave the parts. I have the question I like as little as you will. How much of the summer's takings may be kept back, rather than shared, if playing grows uncertain?

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: I do not like it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Nor I.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Nor I. And I agree with it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A share of an empty yard is a very clean sum. Keep something back. Do not ask me to be glad of the sentence.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nobody is glad of it. We are agreeing to the right, and we are not naming a sum tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Name the right. Leave the figure in the bag until a Saturday that needs a figure.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The almanac has Trinity term on the twentieth.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The twentieth. Eighteen days off. The gowns come back then. The Inns come with them. The appetite may take longer.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Eighteen days of the stock we already know. I can wait eighteen days to talk about a king. I have already played Errors once today, and I am not rehearsing it again to fill the silence.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Errors is done for today. The king is not for this week. Eighteen days is the term, not a promise of a play.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then I have asked what I came to ask. The Master can be shown a chronicle. I would rather he were shown that than a surprise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: He will see what is written, when it is written. Tonight the only thing open on the chest is the almanac.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I see no part. I can bear no part. I could not bear a part you were keeping in your sleeve. You are not keeping one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not keeping one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then the map is this. Monday the ninth, the comedy. Three weeks of the old stock. A king for Michaelmas, about to be unkinged, and not promised before that. Takings kept back if the summer thins, and no figure on it. Trinity term on the twentieth, eighteen days off. If that is all of it, I will shut the almanac.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Shut it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Shut it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Shut it. And may the Master be in a temper to read a chronicle, when there is a chronicle to read.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Shut it.
